result.title: Optimize the Cob, Then the Kernel: Optimizing Beam Search for Generative Recommendation Inference
result.summary: Generative recommendation (GR) inference differs substantially from conventional LLM serving, featuring long input sequences, wide beam search, and only a few fixed output tokens. Existing LLM serving engines such as vLLM process beams as batched independent sequences, causing redundant KV cache accesses over the shared prompt prefix. Furthermore, vLLM executes each beam search generation step as a separate engine invocation, incurring host-side beam processing overhead between decoding steps and substantial runtime KV block management in PagedAttention. Using Tree Attention, we concatenate beams along the sequence dimension to eliminate redundant KV accesses, and further optimize execution through pre-generated partial-attention masks, static KV cache allocation, loop-unrolled generation dispatch, TorchAir graph compilation, automatic operator fusion, and vocabulary-constrained decoding. Without the use of custom kernels, our approach reduces end-to-end latency by up to 25x over vLLM on Ascend NPUs, and achieves generation latency comparable to a SOTA solution using custom kernels, showing that the generation pipeline should be optimized holistically before resorting to custom kernel development.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文针对生成式推荐的推理阶段，指出 vLLM 将各 beam 视为独立序列导致共享前缀 KV 重复访问、且每步解码单独调用引擎带来主机侧开销，于是用 Tree Attention 沿序列维拼接 beam，并配合预生成部分注意力掩码、静态 KV 分配、循环展开派发与图编译等手段，在 Ascend NPU 上无需自定义算子即取得最高 25 倍端到端加速。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「多假设共享前缀 KV + 结构化注意力掩码」的做法，可能为 LVR 中多 latent 假设的搜索式推演与缓存/注意力结构管理提供系统层线索，可供核查其假设管理与状态共享能否迁移到 latent beam 搜索。
